title: ColdNodePayload
description: Schema for decoupled raw cold storage historical node files (IPCF-1.1). Each file stores one archived turn with three hash identities per CONFORMANCE.md §2.

step_id.description: Canonical turn index sourced from conversation history.

folded_at.description: UTC timestamp when this node was folded.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the folded turn.

raw_content.description: Full verbatim content of the archived turn (lossless, CONF-01).

normalized_content.description: Source content normalized to UTF-8 NFC with trailing whitespace stripped.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of raw source content before folding. Immutable content identity (CONF-02).

projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the 8 canonical projection fields in fixed order. Deterministic logical identity (CONF-11).

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON serialization of cold node with artifact_sha256 omitted/null. Physical serialization integrity (CONF-09).

identifiers.description: Sorted, deduplicated identifiers extracted from turn content.

files.description: Sorted, deduplicated file paths referenced in the turn.

commands.description: Sorted, deduplicated shell/tool commands executed in the turn.

errors.description: Sorted, deduplicated error and exception types recorded in the turn.

token_estimate.description: Rough token count estimate (~4 chars per token). Reference heuristic only.

sanitized.description: True if API tokens, passwords, and credentials have been scrubbed before writing to disk.

original_prompt.description: Optional: the exact user prompt that produced this turn.

raw_tool_calls.description: Raw tool call records from the archived turn.

code_diffs.description: Code diffs produced during this turn.
